summary.subject: ant lsp: the language server (spec/lsp.md) in internal/lsp, speaking JSON-RPC over stdio with its own framing and the protocol types it uses, each open document the root of its own program with every open document standing in for its file, positions in UTF-16 or utf-8 as the client offers; diagnostics of the loader and the checker as ranges, one on each import whose module has errors, published on open and change; hover with the type at the use, narrowed, the signature as written, and the doc comment rendered by doc.md; definition across modules, into the prelude through the read-only document ant:/prelude.ant that the request ant/source serves, and from an import's path to its file; references, document highlight, and rename, of an import's alias within its module, of an export in every workspace module that imports the declaring one, refusing keywords, reserved words, prelude names, fields, and namespaces; document symbols with fields and functions on types nested, workspace symbols over the workspace folders; formatting with ant fmt as one edit around what changed; folding, selection ranges, semantic tokens with element and attribute types for markup, inlay hints for inferred var types and parameter names; completion of names in scope, members after a dot and fields of a record, functions whose first parameter takes the left side after a pipe, parameters as name:, a record literal's missing fields, import paths and exports, types and is targets, and in markup the elements, attributes, and end tag, found by parsing the document again with a placeholder where the name is typed; signature help with the active parameter, counting from the second through a pipe; Info records type parameters' declarations and locals' modules, a record entry being typed parses as a shorthand, and Import keeps where its namespace is written; cmd/ant gains lsp with its usage and shell completion; tests drive a server over pipes on a two-module workspace
